Name: Auto Hoe
Author: Xpc20040209
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Automatically tills the tile in front of you when holding a hoe. Press H to toggle. Stamina protection with customizable keybinding and minimum stamina threshold. Makes your Stardew Valley farming life easier!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI (https://smapi.io/)
2. Extract the zip file and place the "AutoHoe" folder into your game's Mods directory
  Default path: Stardew Valley/Mods/AutoHoe/
3. Launch the game through SMAPI
4. Look for "Loaded Auto Hoe 1.0.0" in the SMAPI console to confirm successful installation

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
• Auto Tilling — Automatically hoes the tile in front of you when holding a Hoe tool
• Smart Detection — Skips already-tilled tiles, occupied tiles, and out-of-bounds areas
• Stamina Protection — Pauses automatically when stamina drops below the configurable threshold
• Hotkey Toggle — Press H (configurable) at any time to enable/disable auto-hoe
• Customizable — Edit config.json to change the toggle key, minimum stamina, and default state
• Lightweight — No texture replacements, no content patching, works with most mods

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
• Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher
• SMAPI 3.0 or higher (https://smapi.io/)

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI, and to the Stardew Valley modding community for their helpful resources!
